# Product Requirements Document (PRD)

**Product Name:** Impostor Word Game *(Working Title)*

**Document Version:** v1.0

**Target Platform:** Web (Desktop & Mobile Responsive) / Progressive Web App (PWA)

**Target Audience:** Casual party gamers, families, friend groups (3 to 20 players)

---

## 1. Executive Summary & Objectives

The **Impostor Word Game** is a lightweight, real-time social deduction party game playable either in-person passing a single device or remotely across individual devices.

### Objectives

* **Product Vision:** Deliver a frictionless, zero-install party game experience where players describe a secret word through single-word clues, trying to catch the "Impostor" who doesn't know the word.
* **Primary KPI:** 70%+ session completion rate across multi-round sessions.
* **Secondary KPI:** Average session time > 15 minutes (~3–5 rounds per game).

---

## 2. Core Player Roles & Win Conditions

| Role | Knowledge Base | Objective | Win Condition |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| **Citizens** | Knowledge of Secret Word | Give distinct clues, identify and vote out the Impostor. | Correctly vote out the Impostor during the voting phase. |
| **Impostor** | Knows category only (or no info, based on game mode) | Blend in, give believable clues, avoid detection. | Avoid being voted out **OR** guess the secret word if caught (Last Guess mechanic). |

---

## 3. Detailed Game Flow

```
[Lobby Setup] ──> [Role Assignment] ──> [Clue Phase (1–3 Rounds)] ──> [Discussion & Voting] ──> [Reveal & Scoring]
                                                                                                    │
                                                                                 (Optional)         ▼
                                                                             [Impostor Last Guess]

```

### Phase 1: Lobby Setup

1. **Host Configuration:** Select player count (3–20 players), category (e.g., Movies, Animals, Tech, Food), timer per turn, and game mode.
2. **Device Mode Selection:**
* **Pass & Play Mode:** One phone/tablet is passed around.
* **Multi-Device Lobby:** Host creates a room code; players join via URL/QR code on their own mobile devices.



### Phase 2: Role Assignment & Card Peek

1. System selects a random secret word from the chosen category.
2. System randomly assigns 1 to 3 players as Impostors (based on group size settings).
3. **Card Reveal Mechanics:**
* *Pass & Play:* Player taps "Show My Word", reads, then taps "Hide & Pass".
* *Multi-Device:* Player holds a "Press and Hold to Reveal" button on their personal screen.



### Phase 3: Clue Round

1. Play proceeds clockwise (or designated sequential order).
2. Each player gives **one word or short phrase** relating to the secret word.
3. Configurable turn timer (default: 30 seconds per player).
4. Typical games last 2 to 3 full passes around the group before voting.

### Phase 4: Discussion & Voting

1. **Open Discussion:** A global timer (e.g., 2–5 minutes) starts for debate.
2. **Voting:**
* *Pass & Play:* Players raise hands or point physically on count of three.
* *Multi-Device:* Players vote secretively on-screen.



### Phase 5: Reveal & Last Chance

1. The player with the most votes is eliminated and their identity is revealed.
2. **Impostor Steal Rule (House Rule setting):** If the Impostor is voted out, they get **one attempt** to type/guess the secret word. If correct, the Impostor steals the win.

---

## 4. Feature Specifications

### 4.1 Game Modes

* **Classic Mode:** Citizens receive the exact secret word; Impostor receives "You are the Impostor".
* **Mysterious Mode:** Citizens receive the secret word (e.g., *Lion*); Impostor receives a similar word from the same category (e.g., *Tiger*).
* **Chaotic Mode:** Impostor count is randomized per round without revealing how many Impostors are active.

### 4.2 Core Functional Requirements

```
PRD-REQ-001: Category & Word Bank Engine
  ├── Static built-in categories (Animals, Cinema, Food, Tech, Brands, Travel)
  ├── Custom Word List Generator (Host can enter custom comma-separated words)
  └── Difficulty tags per category (Easy, Medium, Hard)

PRD-REQ-002: Pass-and-Play UX
  ├── Card Flip Animation (Hide/Show state)
  ├── Haptic Feedback on role reveal (Mobile devices)
  └── High-contrast UI to prevent screen peeking from adjacent players

PRD-REQ-003: Multi-Device Room Management
  ├── WebSocket / Real-time connection engine (WebSockets / Socket.io / Firebase)
  ├── 4-letter Room Code generation
  └── Host controls: Kick player, Transfer host, Force start round

```

---

## 5. Non-Functional Requirements (NFRs)

* **Performance:** Real-time synchronization latency under 150ms for multi-device events.
* **Compatibility:** Fully responsive across iOS Safari, Android Chrome, and Desktop Web.
* **Accessibility:** Minimum WCAG 2.1 AA compliance (high text contrast, clear touch targets $\ge 48\text{px}$).
* **Security:** Game state (who the Impostor is and the secret word) stored exclusively server-side in multi-device mode to prevent client-side inspection/cheating.

---

## 6. Out of Scope for Phase 1 (v1.0)

* Public matchmaking with strangers (Private rooms only).
* Integrated audio/video chat (Players use external channels like Discord or play in person).
* In-app purchases or account creation (Session-based guest access only).

// Plays real rounds over WebSockets: modes, multi-pass clues, turn timers,
// elimination + last guess, host controls, custom word banks, and Pass & Play.
// Run: npm test
import WebSocket from 'ws';

const URL = process.env.WS_URL || 'ws://localhost:5173/ws';
let failures = 0;
let checks = 0;

function ok(cond, label) {
  checks += 1;
  if (cond) console.log(`  ✓ ${label}`);
  else { failures += 1; console.error(`  ✗ FAIL: ${label}`); }
}
function group(name) { console.log(`\n${name}`); }

class Client {
  constructor(name) {
    this.name = name;
    this.view = null;
    this.id = null;
    this.code = null;
    this.errors = [];
    this.sentClues = new Set();
  }
  connect() {
    return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
      this.ws = new WebSocket(URL);
      this.ws.on('error', reject);
      this.ws.on('open', resolve);
      this.ws.on('message', (raw) => {
        const m = JSON.parse(raw.toString());
        if (m.t === 'room') this.view = m;
        else if (m.t === 'you') { this.id = m.id; this.code = m.code; }
        else if (m.t === 'error') this.errors.push(m.msg);
      });
    });
  }
  send(msg) { this.ws.send(JSON.stringify(msg)); }
  close() { try { this.ws.close(); } catch { /* ignore */ } }
  until(pred, ms = 5000, label = 'condition') {
    const t0 = Date.now();
    return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
      const iv = setInterval(() => {
        if (pred()) { clearInterval(iv); resolve(); }
        else if (Date.now() - t0 > ms) { clearInterval(iv); reject(new Error(`timeout waiting for ${label} (phase=${this.view && this.view.phase})`)); }
      }, 20);
    });
  }
}

const sleep = (ms) => new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, ms));

// Every connected client answers its own clue turn as soon as it comes up.
async function clueRound(devices, wordFor, host) {
  const deadline = Date.now() + 15000;
  while (host.view.phase === 'clues') {
    if (Date.now() > deadline) throw new Error('clue round did not finish');
    for (const c of devices) {
      const v = c.view;
      if (v && v.phase === 'clues' && v.turnId === c.id) {
        const key = `${v.pass}:${c.id}`;
        if (!c.sentClues.has(key)) {
          c.sentClues.add(key);
          c.send({ t: 'clue', word: wordFor(c, v) });
        }
      }
    }
    await sleep(25);
  }
}

const start = Date.now();
const log = (s) => console.log(`\n[${((Date.now() - start) / 1000).toFixed(1)}s] ${s}`);

try {
  // ------------------------------------------------------------- lobby + config
  log('4 players create and join');
  const clients = ['Ada', 'Ben', 'Cid', 'Dee'].map((n) => new Client(n));
  await Promise.all(clients.map((c) => c.connect()));
  const [A, B, C, D] = clients;
  A.send({ t: 'create', name: A.name });
  await A.until(() => A.code, 3000, 'room code');
  ok(/^[A-Z2-9]{4}$/.test(A.code), `4-letter room code (${A.code})`);
  for (const c of [B, C, D]) c.send({ t: 'join', code: A.code, name: c.name });
  await A.until(() => A.view.players.length === 4, 4000, 'lobby fills');
  ok(A.view.phase === 'lobby', 'phase = lobby');
  ok(A.view.isHost && !B.view.isHost, 'only the host controls the room');
  ok(A.view.limits.max === 20 && A.view.limits.min === 3, `player limits 3–20 (${JSON.stringify(A.view.limits)})`);
  ok(A.view.categories.length >= 10 && A.view.categories.every((c) => c.difficulty && c.count > 0), 'categories ship with difficulty tags');
  ok(A.view.settings.mode === 'mysterious' && A.view.settings.passes === 2 && A.view.settings.turnTimer === 30 && A.view.settings.discussTimer === 120 && A.view.settings.lastGuess === true, 'PRD default settings');

  group('host configuration');
  A.send({
    t: 'settings',
    mode: 'classic', impostors: 1, passes: 1, turnTimer: 0, discussTimer: 60,
    lastGuess: true, category: 'Animals', maxPlayers: 12,
  });
  await B.until(() => B.view.settings.mode === 'classic', 4000, 'settings propagate');
  const s = B.view.settings;
  ok(s.mode === 'classic' && s.impostors === 1 && s.passes === 1 && s.turnTimer === 0 && s.discussTimer === 60 && s.maxPlayers === 12, 'settings reach every player');
  B.send({ t: 'settings', mode: 'chaotic' });
  await A.until(() => A.view.settings.mode === 'chaotic', 4000, 'non-host rejected');
  ok(A.view.settings.mode === 'classic', 'non-host cannot change settings');

  group('custom word bank');
  const custom = 'witch, broom, cauldron, spell, wand, potion, ghost, mirror'.toUpperCase().split(', ');
  A.send({ t: 'settings', customWords: 'witch, broom, cauldron, spell, wand, potion, ghost, mirror' });
  await A.until(() => A.view.categories.some((c) => c.key === 'custom'), 4000, 'custom category appears');
  ok(A.view.categories.find((c) => c.key === 'custom').count === 8, 'custom word list parsed');
  A.send({ t: 'settings', category: 'custom' });
  await A.until(() => A.view.settings.category === 'custom', 4000, 'custom selected');

  // --------------------------------------------------------------- round one
  log('round 1 — classic mode, one impostor, one clue pass');
  A.send({ t: 'start' });
  await A.until(() => A.view.phase === 'reveal', 4000, 'reveal');
  const imp = clients.find((c) => c.view.youAreImpostor);

  ok(Boolean(imp) && crew.length === 3, 'exactly one impostor (impostors: 1)');

  await clueRound(clients, () => 'hintword', A);
  ok(A.view.phase === 'discuss', 'discussion opens after the pass');
  ok(A.view.clues.length === 4 && A.view.clues.every((c) => c.pass === 1), `4 clues collected (${A.view.clues.map((c) => c.text).join(', ')})`);

  group('voting — everyone skips, then a skip-vote continues the round');
  A.send({ t: 'skipTimer' });
  await A.until(() => A.view.phase === 'vote', 4000, 'vote');
  for (const c of clients) c.send({ t: 'vote', target: 'skip' });
  await A.until(() => A.view.phase === 'tally', 4000, 'tally');
  ok(A.view.voteCounts.skip === 4, 'vote counts revealed at tally');
  ok(A.view.eliminatedNow === null, 'no elimination on a skip vote');
  A.send({ t: 'continue' });
  await A.until(() => A.view.phase === 'clues', 5000, 'clues again');
  ok(A.view.pass === 1, 'a fresh clue pass starts after a tied/skipped vote');

  group('voting — impostor voted out, then steals with the last guess');
  await clueRound(clients, () => 'anotherhint', A);
  await A.until(() => A.view.phase === 'discuss', 8000, 'discussion 2');
  A.send({ t: 'skipTimer' });
  await A.until(() => A.view.phase === 'vote', 4000, 'vote 2');
  for (const c of clients) c.send({ t: 'vote', target: c.id === imp.id ? crew[0].id : imp.id });
  await A.until(() => A.view.phase === 'tally', 4000, 'tally 2');
  ok(A.view.eliminatedNow && A.view.eliminatedNow.id === imp.id && A.view.eliminatedNow.isImpostor, 'eliminated player\'s identity is revealed');
  ok(B.view.eliminatedNow && B.view.eliminatedNow.isImpostor, 'everyone sees the reveal');
  A.send({ t: 'continue' });
  await A.until(() => A.view.phase === 'guess', 5000, 'last guess');
  ok(Array.isArray(imp.view.guessOptions) && imp.view.guessOptions.length === 3, 'impostor gets 3 word options');
  ok(crew[0].view.guessOptions == null, 'options are hidden from crew');

# Product Requirements Document (PRD)

**Product Name:** Impostor Word Game *(Working Title)*

**Document Version:** v1.0

**Target Platform:** Web (Desktop & Mobile Responsive) / Progressive Web App (PWA)

**Target Audience:** Casual party gamers, families, friend groups (3 to 20 players)

---

## 1. Executive Summary & Objectives

The **Impostor Word Game** is a lightweight, real-time social deduction party game playable either in-person passing a single device or remotely across individual devices.

### Objectives

* **Product Vision:** Deliver a frictionless, zero-install party game experience where players describe a secret word through single-word clues, trying to catch the "Impostor" who doesn't know the word.
* **Primary KPI:** 70%+ session completion rate across multi-round sessions.
* **Secondary KPI:** Average session time > 15 minutes (~3–5 rounds per game).

---

## 2. Core Player Roles & Win Conditions

| Role | Knowledge Base | Objective | Win Condition |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| **Citizens** | Knowledge of Secret Word | Give distinct clues, identify and vote out the Impostor. | Correctly vote out the Impostor during the voting phase. |
| **Impostor** | Knows category only (or no info, based on game mode) | Blend in, give believable clues, avoid detection. | Avoid being voted out **OR** guess the secret word if caught (Last Guess mechanic). |

---

## 3. Detailed Game Flow

```
[Lobby Setup] ──> [Role Assignment] ──> [Clue Phase (1–3 Rounds)] ──> [Discussion & Voting] ──> [Reveal & Scoring]
                                                                                                    │
                                                                                 (Optional)         ▼
                                                                             [Impostor Last Guess]

```

### Phase 1: Lobby Setup

1. **Host Configuration:** Select player count (3–20 players), category (e.g., Movies, Animals, Tech, Food), timer per turn, and game mode.
2. **Device Mode Selection:**
* **Pass & Play Mode:** One phone/tablet is passed around.
* **Multi-Device Lobby:** Host creates a room code; players join via URL/QR code on their own mobile devices.



### Phase 2: Role Assignment & Card Peek

1. System selects a random secret word from the chosen category.
2. System randomly assigns 1 to 3 players as Impostors (based on group size settings).
3. **Card Reveal Mechanics:**
* *Pass & Play:* Player taps "Show My Word", reads, then taps "Hide & Pass".
* *Multi-Device:* Player holds a "Press and Hold to Reveal" button on their personal screen.



### Phase 3: Clue Round

1. Play proceeds clockwise (or designated sequential order).
2. Each player gives **one word or short phrase** relating to the secret word.
3. Configurable turn timer (default: 30 seconds per player).
4. Typical games last 2 to 3 full passes around the group before voting.

### Phase 4: Discussion & Voting

1. **Open Discussion:** A global timer (e.g., 2–5 minutes) starts for debate.
2. **Voting:**
* *Pass & Play:* Players raise hands or point physically on count of three.
* *Multi-Device:* Players vote secretively on-screen.



### Phase 5: Reveal & Last Chance

1. The player with the most votes is eliminated and their identity is revealed.
2. **Impostor Steal Rule (House Rule setting):** If the Impostor is voted out, they get **one attempt** to type/guess the secret word. If correct, the Impostor steals the win.

---

## 4. Feature Specifications

### 4.1 Game Modes

* **Classic Mode:** Citizens receive the exact secret word; Impostor receives "You are the Impostor".
* **Mysterious Mode:** Citizens receive the secret word (e.g., *Lion*); Impostor receives a similar word from the same category (e.g., *Tiger*).
* **Chaotic Mode:** Impostor count is randomized per round without revealing how many Impostors are active.

### 4.2 Core Functional Requirements

```
PRD-REQ-001: Category & Word Bank Engine
  ├── Static built-in categories (Animals, Cinema, Food, Tech, Brands, Travel)
  ├── Custom Word List Generator (Host can enter custom comma-separated words)
  └── Difficulty tags per category (Easy, Medium, Hard)

PRD-REQ-002: Pass-and-Play UX
  ├── Card Flip Animation (Hide/Show state)
  ├── Haptic Feedback on role reveal (Mobile devices)
  └── High-contrast UI to prevent screen peeking from adjacent players

PRD-REQ-003: Multi-Device Room Management
  ├── WebSocket / Real-time connection engine (WebSockets / Socket.io / Firebase)
  ├── 4-letter Room Code generation
  └── Host controls: Kick player, Transfer host, Force start round

```

---

## 5. Non-Functional Requirements (NFRs)

* **Performance:** Real-time synchronization latency under 150ms for multi-device events.
* **Compatibility:** Fully responsive across iOS Safari, Android Chrome, and Desktop Web.
* **Accessibility:** Minimum WCAG 2.1 AA compliance (high text contrast, clear touch targets $\ge 48\text{px}$).
* **Security:** Game state (who the Impostor is and the secret word) stored exclusively server-side in multi-device mode to prevent client-side inspection/cheating.

---

## 6. Out of Scope for Phase 1 (v1.0)

* Public matchmaking with strangers (Private rooms only).
* Integrated audio/video chat (Players use external channels like Discord or play in person).
* In-app purchases or account creation (Session-based guest access only).

{"kind":"tool","id":"RyGI2qzlEwM","toolName":"write_file","input":{"path":"public/style.css","instructions":"Complete light/white stylesheet for the impostor game UI, replacing the gutted v2 fragment (no theme vars existed).","content":"/* IMPOSTER — light theme. One stylesheet, no build step. */
:root {
  --bg: #ffffff;
  --bg2: #f1f5fa;
  --card: #ffffff;
  --line: #dfe6ee;
  --text: #101820;
  --muted: #5a6675;
  --accent: #0b76c1;
  --accent-soft: #e3f1fb;
  --crew: #2f7d32;
  --crew-dim: #e4f3e2;
  --imp: #c92a2a;
  --imp-dim: #fdeaea;
  --radius: 16px;
  --shadow: 0 1px 2px rgba(16, 24, 40, .06), 0 10px 24px -12px rgba(16, 24, 40, .18);
}

* { box-sizing: border-box; }

html, body {
  margin: 0;
  padding: 0;
  background: var(--bg);
  color: var(--text);
}

body {
  font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", Roboto, "Helvetica Neue", Arial, sans-serif;
  font-size: 16px;
  line-height: 1.5;
  -webkit-font-smoothing: antialiased;
  -webkit-tap-highlight-color: transparent;
}

main#app {
  max-width: 540px;
  margin: 0 auto;
  padding: calc(18px + env(safe-area-inset-top)) 16px calc(40px + env(safe-area-inset-bottom));
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: 14px;
}

h1, h2, h3 { line-height: 1.25; margin: 0 0 8px; }
h1 { font-size: 28px; letter-spacing: .12em; font-weight: 900; }
h2 { font-size: 19px; font-weight: 800; }
h3 { font-size: 13px; font-weight: 800; letter-spacing: .08em; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--muted); }
p { margin: 8px 0; }
b { font-weight: 800; }

label {
  display: block;
  font-size: 13px;
  font-weight: 700;
  color: var(--muted);
  margin-bottom: 6px;
}

input, textarea {
  width: 100%;
  background: #fff;
  border: 1.5px solid var(--line);
  color: var(--text);
  border-radius: 12px;
  padding: 12px 14px;
  font-size: 16px;
  font-family: inherit;
  resize: vertical;
}
input:focus, textarea:focus { border-color: var(--accent); outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px var(--accent-soft); }
input::placeholder, textarea::placeholder { color: #93a0af; }

:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--accent); outline-offset: 2px; }

/* ------------------------------------------------------------------ buttons */
button {
  font: inherit;
  font-weight: 800;
  color: var(--text);
  background: #fff;
  border: 1.5px solid var(--line);
  border-radius: 12px;
  padding: 11px 18px;
  min-height: 48px;
  cursor: pointer;
  transition: transform .06s ease, background .15s ease, border-color .15s ease;
}
button:hover { border-color: #b9c5d2; }
button:active { transform: scale(.98); }
button:disabled { opacity: .45; cursor: not-allowed; transform: none; }
button.big { min-height: 56px; font-size: 18px; }
button.small { min-height: 40px; font-size: 14px; padding: 8px 14px; }
button.block { width: 100%; display: block; }
button.primary { background: var(--accent); border-color: var(--accent); color: #fff; }
button.primary:hover { background: #0a68ab; border-color: #0a68ab; }
button.danger { background: var(--imp); border-color: var(--imp); color: #fff; }
button.danger:hover { background: #ad2323; border-color: #ad2323; }
button.ghost { background: transparent; }

.row { display: flex; gap: 10px; }
.row > button { flex: 1; }
.spacer { height: 12px; }
.divider { height: 1px; background: var(--line); margin: 16px 0; }
.center { text-align: center; }
.muted { color: var(--muted); }
.hidden { display: none !important; }

.sr-only {
  position: absolute; width: 1px; height: 1px; padding: 0; margin: -1px;
  overflow: hidden; clip: rect(0 0 0 0); white-space: nowrap; border: 0;
}

/* ------------------------------------------------------------- brand & cards */
.brand { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px; }
.brand h1 { margin: 0; }
.brand .dot {
  width: 14px; height: 14px; border-radius: 50%; flex: none;
  background: radial-gradient(circle at 35% 30%, #6fd3ff, var(--accent));
}
.tag { color: var(--muted); margin: -4px 0 4px; }

.card {
  background: var(--card);
  border: 1px solid var(--line);
  border-radius: var(--radius);
  box-shadow: var(--shadow);
  padding: 18px;
}
details.card summary { list-style: none; cursor: pointer; font-weight: 700; }
details.card summary::-webkit-details-marker { display: none; }
details.card summary::after { content: " ▾"; color: var(--muted); }

.codebox {
  text-align: center;
  background: var(--accent-soft);
  border: 1px solid #cbe6f7;
  border-radius: var(--radius);
  padding: 16px 18px;
}
.codebox .code {
  font-size: clamp(38px, 12vw, 52px);
  font-weight: 900;
  letter-spacing: .18em;
  color: var(--accent);
  line-height: 1.1;
}
.codebox .hint { font-size: 12px; color: var(--muted); }

/* ------------------------------------------------------------------- players */
.players { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 8px; }
.chip {
  display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px;
  background: #fff;
  border: 1.5px solid var(--line);
  border-radius: 999px;
  padding: 7px 16px 7px 7px;
  font-weight: 700;
  overflow: hidden;
}
.chip.host { border-color: var(--accent); background: var(--accent-soft); }
.chip.you { box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px var(--accent-soft); }
.chip.out { opacity: .55; text-decoration: line-through; }
.chip.off { opacity: .45; }
.chip .tagpill {
  font-size: 10px; font-weight: 900; letter-spacing: .08em;
  background: var(--accent); color: #fff;
  border-radius: 999px; padding: 3px 8px; flex: none;
}
.chip .tagpill.outpill { background: var(--imp-dim); color: var(--imp); text-decoration: none; }
.avatar {
  width: 34px; height: 34px; border-radius: 50%; flex: none;
  display: grid; place-items: center;
  color: #101820; font-weight: 900; font-size: 15px;
}
button.kick {
  margin-left: auto; width: 34px; min-height: 34px; padding: 0; border-radius: 50%;
  background: var(--imp-dim); color: var(--imp); border: none;
  font-size: 19px; line-height: 1; flex: none;
}
button.kick:hover { background: #fbd6d6; }

.picker { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 8px; }
.picker button { min-height: 46px; border-radius: 999px; padding: 9px 16px; font-weight: 700; }
.picker button.on { background: var(--accent); border-color: var(--accent); color: #fff; }
.catmeta { font-size: 11px; color: var(--muted); font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: .04em; }
.picker button.on .catmeta { color: rgba(255, 255, 255, .85); }

.badge { font-size: 10px; font-weight: 900; letter-spacing: .08em; border-radius: 999px; padding: 3px 9px; flex: none; }
.badge.crew { background: var(--crew-dim); color: var(--crew); }
.badge.imp { background: var(--imp-dim); color: var(--imp); }

/* -------------------------------------------------------------------- status */
.status {
  background: var(--bg2);
  border: 1px dashed var(--line);
  border-radius: var(--radius);
  padding: 20px 18px;
  text-align: center;
  font-weight: 600;
}

.turnbar {
  display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; gap: 12px;
  background: var(--bg2);
  border: 1px solid var(--line);
  border-radius: var(--radius);
  padding: 12px 16px;
  font-weight: 800;
}
.turnbar .mine { color: var(--crew); }
.clock { font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; font-weight: 900; font-size: 18px; }
.clock.urgent { color: var(--imp); animation: pulse 1s infinite; }
@keyframes pulse { 50% { opacity: .45; } }

/* --------------------------------------------------------------------- clues */
.clues { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 8px; margin-bottom: 10px; }
.clue {
  display: flex; align-items: baseline; gap: 10px;
  background: var(--bg2);
  border-radius: 12px;
  padding: 10px 14px;
}
.clue .who { font-size: 13px; font-weight: 800; color: var(--muted); flex: none; }
.clue .w { font-weight: 700; overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis; }
.clue.mine { background: var(--accent-soft); }
.clue.mine .w { color: var(--accent); }

/* --------------------------------------------------------------------- chats */
.chat {
  max-height: 220px; overflow-y: auto;
  background: var(--bg2);
  border-radius: 12px;
  padding: 10px 12px;
  display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 5px;
}
.msg { font-size: 15px; overflow-wrap: anywhere; }
.msg .from { font-weight: 800; }
.msg.sys { color: var(--muted); font-style: italic; font-size: 14px; }
.chatform { display: flex; gap: 8px; margin-top: 10px; }
.chatform input { flex: 1; }
.chatform button { flex: none; }

/* -------------------------------------------------------------------- votes */
.ballot { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fill, minmax(140px, 1fr)); gap: 10px; }
.vote { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px; font-weight: 800; padding: 9px 14px; text-align: left; }
.vote.sel { border-color: var(--accent); background: var(--accent-soft); box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px var(--accent-soft); }

.tallyrow { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px; padding: 5px 0; }
.tallyrow .name { flex: none; min-width: 84px; font-weight: 700; overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis; white-space: nowrap; }
.tallyrow .bar { flex: 1; height: 12px; background: var(--bg2); border-radius: 999px; overflow: hidden; }
.tallyrow .fill { display: block; height: 100%; background: linear-gradient(90deg, #7cb9e8, var(--accent)); border-radius: 999px; }
.tallyrow .fill.score { background: linear-gradient(90deg, #9ad49a, var(--crew)); }
.tallyrow .n { flex: none; font-weight: 900; min-width: 20px; text-align: right; }

.options { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 10px; }
.options button { font-size: 17px; }

/* ------------------------------------------------------------------- result */
.result {
  text-align: center;
  border-radius: var(--radius);
  padding: 26px 18px;
  border: 1px solid var(--line);
}
.result.crew { background: var(--crew-dim); border-color: #c4e6bf; }
.result.imp { background: var(--imp-dim); border-color: #f6c9c9; }
.result .emoji { font-size: 46px; }
.result .title { font-size: 24px; font-weight: 900; letter-spacing: .04em; margin-top: 6px; }
.result.crew .title { color: var(--crew); }
.result.imp .title { color: var(--imp); }
.result .reason { color: var(--muted); margin-top: 4px; }
.result .secret {
  display: inline-block;
  margin-top: 10px;
  background: #fff;
  border: 1.5px dashed var(--line);
  border-radius: 999px;
  padding: 7px 18px;
  font-weight: 900;
  font-size: 18px;
}

/* -------------------------------------------------------------- role / hold */
.rolecard { text-align: center; }
.rolecard .who { font-size: 14px; font-weight: 900; letter-spacing: .06em; text-transform: uppercase; }
.rolecard.crew .who { color: var(--crew); }
.rolecard.imp .who { color: var(--imp); }

.holdwrap {
  display: block; width: 100%; min-height: 210px; position: relative; overflow: hidden;
  background: var(--bg2); border: 2px dashed #c3cfdb; border-radius: 18px; margin-top: 14px; padding: 0;
  touch-action: none; user-select: none; -webkit-user-select: none;
}
.holdwrap .holdhint {
  position: absolute; inset: 0; display: grid; place-items: center;
  color: var(--muted); font-size: 15px; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: .1em; text-transform: uppercase;
}
.holdwrap .holdface {
  position: absolute; inset: 0; display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; justify-content: center;
  gap: 8px; opacity: 0; transition: opacity .12s ease; background: linear-gradient(180deg, #ffffff, var(--bg2));
}
.holdwrap.on { border-style: solid; }
.holdwrap.on .holdface { opacity: 1; }
.holdwrap.on .holdhint { opacity: 0; }
.rolecard.crew .holdwrap.on { border-color: var(--crew); }
.rolecard.imp .holdwrap.on { border-color: var(--imp); }
.holdwrap .word { font-size: clamp(30px, 10vw, 46px); font-weight: 900; letter-spacing: .04em; color: var(--text); text-transform: lowercase; }
.holdwrap .cat { font-size: 12px; letter-spacing: .2em; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--muted); }
.holdwrap .note { font-size: 13px; color: var(--muted); padding: 0 18px; text-align: center; line-height: 1.5; }

/* -------------------------------------------------------------- pass & play */
.handoff {
  text-align: center; padding: 26px 18px; border-radius: var(--radius);
  background: var(--card); border: 1px solid var(--line); box-shadow: var(--shadow);
}
.handoff-icon { font-size: 46px; }
.handoff h2 { margin: 10px 0 16px; }
.passchip {
  display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px; background: var(--bg2);
  border: 1px solid var(--line); border-radius: 999px; padding: 7px 20px 7px 7px;
  font-weight: 800; font-size: 18px; margin-bottom: 18px;
}

/* ------------------------------------------------------------------ overlays */
.offline {
  position: fixed; top: calc(8px + env(safe-area-inset-top)); left: 50%; transform: translateX(-50%);
  z-index: 40; background: var(--imp); color: #fff;
  font-weight: 800; font-size: 14px;
  border-radius: 999px; padding: 8px 18px;
  box-shadow: var(--shadow);
}
.toast {
  position: fixed; bottom: calc(20px + env(safe-area-inset-bottom)); left: 50%; transform: translateX(-50%);
  z-index: 40; max-width: min(92vw, 420px);
  background: var(--text); color: #fff;
  font-weight: 700; font-size: 15px;
  border-radius: 12px; padding: 12px 18px;
  box-shadow: var(--shadow);
  text-align: center;
}

A real-time, multiplayer **word party game** for 3–20 players — the impostor game,
now a installable PWA.

Everyone gets the **same secret word**… except one or more players, who secretly
get a **different word from the same category**. Give one-word clues, argue about
who doesn't belong, and vote them out. If an impostor survives the vote, they get
one guess at the real word to steal the win.

## Run it

```bash
npm install   # just the `ws` WebSocket library
npm start     # serves the game on http://localhost:5173
```

Then open `http://localhost:5173`. Two ways to play:

- **Multi-device** — create a room, share the **4-letter room code**. Friends on
  the same Wi-Fi open the LAN address shown in the lobby (e.g. `http://10.200.34.43:5173`)
  and enter the code.
- **Pass & Play** — one phone passed around the table. Add 3–10 names; the game
  hands the device to each player in turn ("look away" screens between turns).

```bash
npm test      # end-to-end test: plays full rounds over real WebSockets
```

Set `PORT` to serve on a different port.

## Round flow

1. **Deal** — crew all get the same word; each impostor gets a different one from
   the same category (press & hold to peek at your card).
2. **Clues** — one word per player per pass, in turn order (1–3 passes, configurable
   turn timer). Crew may not say the word itself.
3. **Discuss** — timed debate with chat (host can open voting early).
4. **Vote** — one vote each. Most votes is eliminated; ties and skips mean nobody is.
5. **Last guess** *(house rule, on by default)* — an impostor who is voted out gets
   one shot at the real word. Correct guess steals the win.
6. **Reveal & score** — roles, the word, and a running scoreboard. Play again keeps
   the room together.

## Host controls & settings

Game mode (**Classic** — impostor knows nothing, **Mysterious** — impostor gets a
similar decoy word, **Chaotic** — impostor count is random and hidden), category
(including a host-supplied **custom word list**), impostor count, clue passes,
per-turn timer, discussion time, last-guess rule, and room size (6/12/20). The host
can also kick players, transfer host, and force-start with fewer players.

## Layout

- [server.js](server.js) — HTTP + WebSocket server, rooms, and the game state machine
  (all secrets stay server-side)
- [public/index.html](public/index.html), [public/app.js](public/app.js),
  [public/style.css](public/style.css) — the responsive client (light theme, 48px
  touch targets, screen-reader announcements)
- [public/manifest.webmanifest](public/manifest.webmanifest), [public/sw.js](public/sw.js),

- [test/e2e.mjs](test/e2e.mjs) — plays complete rounds and asserts the whole flow

Rooms live in memory: restart the server and the rooms are gone (players are
offered the home screen and can create or join again).
